content: Odem kw'efonamma cha Noa
Ma wọ ode odem kw'efonamma cha Noa ch'ede Shẹm, ọmaana Ham, ttara Japhẹt. Wa va mba akk'abhakhi abhon ayok, k'ogbe kw'iwa asi p'achi ọyagbin akk'akka.
Ẹnọmma cha Japhẹt
Va pa Japhẹt p'ijinọng wa bẹ ade: Goma, ọmaana Magọg, ọmaana Madai, ọmaana Javan, ọmaana Tubal, ọmaana Mẹshẹk, ttara Tiras.
Wa va p'ijinọng pa Goma ade: Askenaz, ọmaana Riphat, ttara Togama.
Va p'ijinọng pa Javan ade: Elisha, ọmaana Tarshish, ọmaana Kitim, ttara Dodanim.

Wa va pa va p'anọng mba, bọ iwa arukhi k'araanga akhaan-ọkhaan, an-abhaangi aruk k'orerek fabẹ, ka mfonamma sabẹ, ọmaana k'ibhon k'ibhon, anọng-ọnọng agbaak ebhon chabẹ. Ma wọ iwa ode ẹnọmma cha Japhẹt.
Ẹnọmma cha Ham
Va pa Ham p'ijinọng bẹ ade: Kush, ọmaana Ijip, ọmaana Put, ttara Kenaan.
Kush ọn-ọbhakhi obhon: Seba, ọmaana Havila, ọmaana Sabata, ọmaana Rama, ttara Sabateka. Wa va pa Rama ade: Sheba, ọmaana Dedan.
Kush wọ iwa obiro ode otte kwa Nimrọd, kw'iwa ode okkenggitza kw'ideden k'ọyagbin.
Nimrọd wa ode ọgbaajijaa kw'ideden k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Kwẹ kwọ osi bẹ am-aben bi, “Macha Nimrọd, kw'ode ogbaajijaa kw'ideden kw'Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọwọbh ọnanga.”
Ichedenmon s'iwa kẹ ọdabhi ẹvaar ide ibhon sa Babẹl, ọmaana Ẹrẹk, ọmaana Akad, ttara Kalnẹ. Ibhon nna biphyir wa s'iwobh k'okhubha kwa Shina.
Ma kw'iwa on-obin ochina k'okhubha kw'Asiriya, otza osi ibhon sa Ninevẹ, ọmaana Rehobot-Ir, ọmaana Kala,
ọmaana Resen, kw'owobh k'ottem kwa Ninevẹ, ttara odedenmon kwa Kala.
Wa Ijip ọbhakhi obhon abaLud, ọmaana abAnam, ttara abaLehab, ọmaana abaNaphatu,
ọmaana abaPatarus, ọmaana abaKasalu, ttara abaKaphatọr. AbaKasalu bọ iwa an-abira abhakhi abhon ẹkhọma cha Philistiya.
Kenaan, kẹ wa ocheden obhon Sidọn, obiro obhon abaHet.
Wa ngọma sa mfon ka Kenaan nde: abaJẹbus, ọmaana abAmọr, ọmaana abaGirgash,
ọmaana abaHiv ọmaana Ak, ọmaana abaSin,
ọmaana abAvad, ọmaana abaZẹma, ttara abaHamat. Wa nnọmma nna biphyir sẹ mfon ka Kenaan, nnyaami
Wa ẹkhọma cha Kenaan etzim maa epyiri Sidọn, ebir etzima ka Gẹra maa etzuma ka Gaza, ebir etzima echina ka Sodom, ọmaana Gomora, ọmaana Adama, ọmaana Zeboyim, maa apyiri ka Lasha.
Ma wọ iwa ode ẹnọmma cha Ham, ka mfonamma sabẹ, ọmaana ka mmon sabẹ, ọmaana k'orerek fabẹ ttara k'ibhon sabẹ.
Ẹnọmma cha Shẹm
Shẹm, kw'iwa Japhẹt otzori nnam, wa obhoni Ẹbẹr, ttara va p'Ẹbẹr obhoni biphyir.
Wa Shẹm obiro obhon va adọdọk p'ade: Ẹlam, ọmaana Ashur, ọmaana Arphaksad, ọmaana Lud, ttara Aram.
Wa va p'Aram ọbhakhi obhon ade Uz, ọmaana Hul, ọmaana Gẹta, ttara Mash.
Arphaksad obhon Shẹla, kw'obiro ọbhakhi obhon Ẹbẹr.
Ẹbẹr, wa obhoni va p'ijinọng afa: Ocheden okpen Pẹlẹg, kw'oyini, ẹbhaangi. K'ogbe kwẹ wọ kw'iwa anọng abhaangi k'ọyagbin, bẹ anyaami aruk k'ibe kpenamkpen; ọgbaanọkka kwa Pẹlẹg okpena Jọktan.
Jọktan wa obhoni Almodad, ọmaana Shẹlẹph, ọmaana Hazamavẹt, ọmaana Jẹra,
ọmaana Hadoram, ọmaana Uzal, ọmaana Dikala,
ọmaana Ọbal, ọmaana Abimayẹl, ọmaana Sheba,
ọmaana Ophir, ọmaana Havila, ttara Jobab. Anọng mba biphyir wa bẹ ade va pa Jọktan.
Wa ẹkhọma ch'anọng mba arukhi ẹttẹwọr ka Mẹsha maa achina ka Sẹphar, ka mgbegbeho sa nwobh k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin.
Ma wọ iwa ode ẹnọmma cha Shẹm ka mfonamma sabẹ, ọmaana ka mmon sabẹ, ọmaana k'orerek fabẹ, ttara k'ibhon sabẹ.
Ma wọ iwa ode mfonamma sa va pa Noa, atzor ka va pa va k'idibhon sabẹ. Wa ofon k'anọng mba, idibhon s'ọyagbin biphyir in-inyaami, k'ogbe kw'asi p'iwa achi ọyagbin akk'akka.
